query: Which staggered-treatment estimators (Callaway & Sant’Anna, Sun & Abraham, others) and software implementations best handle multiple ECB announcements with heterogeneous bank effects?

response.query: Which staggered-treatment estimators (Callaway & Sant’Anna, Sun & Abraham, others) and software implementations best handle multiple ECB announcements with heterogeneous bank effects?
response.answer: Callaway & Sant’Anna’s and Sun & Abraham’s staggered-treatment estimators best handle multiple ECB announcements with heterogeneous bank effects. Software implementations like R’s “diffdeppro” package utilize these estimators effectively.

results.title: Institutional and macroeconomic stability mediate the effect ...
results.content: # Institutional and macroeconomic stability mediate the effect of auctions on renewable energy capacity. Low- and middle-income countries have rapidly adopted auctions to promote renewables. Overall, auctions have a positive effect on the share of renewable capacity. However, average effects are higher for countries with better business environments. Renewable energy (RE) auctions have become an increasingly popular policy instrument for decarbonizing the global energy matrix, and have been rapidly adopted by several countries worldwide. Previous research has used data from higher-income countries and two-way fixed effects models to estimate the impact of auctions on RE capacity, mostly with favorable results. However, these studies did not account for heterogeneous treatment effects across units to explore whether auctions are also effective in countries with unstable business environments. We analyze whether auctions also foster RE in countries experiencing macroeconomic instability or poor institutional quality. We find that auctions positively affect RE capacity, yet the average treatment effects are higher for countries with better business environments.
